description.value:
Moore's hazard body, descended from the Sheol that saved so many lives after the nuke. It goes into reactors, chemical spills and Hot Zones so nobody else has to. It's still ugly, and Moore's engineers have stopped apologizing for that.

Cost: 22,000eb (Luxury)
Humanity Loss: 43 (13d6)
Frame: Beta (14): BODY 14
Eyes: Cybereye ×2
Chrome: Chemical Analyzer, Chipware Socket, Countershell, Enhanced Holophone, Fortified Ankles ×2, Heavy Subdermal Plating, Radiation Detector

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.

Drop it on a character (as GM) to install it with Go Metal.

Item Compendium (2070) • Full Body Conversions
